text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the start of summer camp, where racers train to improve their skills. As for Yukino Bijin…
choice_data_list: That's a lot of stuff you have there.
That's a lot of stuff you have there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This summer's gonna be a real challenge, so I went and prepared everyth'n I needed for it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The folks back home sent me oodles of goodies too! I've got tasty water from Morioka, a nice sun hat… and a watermelon!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure did! We'll be cool as cucumbers with this baby!
choice_data_list: Let's chill it for later, then.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh and… I'm gonna do my darndest at camp, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I have a feeling everyth'n will start look'n up if I can do well at the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Us Umamusume are just so snazzy when we run, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If I can sparkle and shine on the track, folks'll be sure t'look at me diff'rently!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give it my all this summer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've absolutely gotta win the Queen Stakes too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begins a sweltering summer with Yukino Bijin.
